source.title: Harness-of-Harness: Multi-Day Autonomous Software Development with Continual Improvement

limitations: Same-stem PDF absent; extraction completeness and rendered figures unverified
Source-code runtime enforcement and reported experimental results not independently reproduced

loop.planner: D_t = Plan(S, E_(t-1)); main allows read-only artifact context, appendix prompt is scaffold-only
loop.developer: A_t = Dev(A_(t-1), S, D_t); single writer with baseline-change-retest
loop.tester: E_t = QA(read_only(A_t), S, D_t, runtime checks); candidate-bound claim/evidence/status
loop.development_document_retention: Audit artifact; not automatically passed as third state channel to next planner
loop.stop: Prescribed T iterations; Algorithm 1 returns A_T

lifecycle.roles: Separate invocations of same fixed harness-model pair
lifecycle.independence_limit: Role and candidate separation does not imply different models or uncorrelated errors
prime_owner_proposal: Existing daemon and resident session workers own execution and role invocations
Persistent REPL/RLM manages selective evidence context
Native transcripts, artifacts and snapshots retain candidate and recovery lineage

frontierswe.dominance_main_pool: 12 harness-condition configurations; macro average over 3 domains

frontierswe_ten_loop.pool: Vanilla and HoH@1-10 for Codex/GPT-5.5 only

fps_case.human_intervention: network/API availability restoration only, per authors

measurement_limits: One valid run per task-condition; infrastructure/transport failures replaced
No common reproducible model generation seed; task bootstrap is not repeated-run uncertainty
Token accounting excludes benchmark evaluator and can include cached inputs; compare within configuration only
Pass-matched comparison does not exactly match tokens, invocation count, time or monetary cost
Table 24 per-column cumulative semantics are insufficiently clear for whole-run cost
Full FPS monetary cost, tool/asset cost, recovery labor and hard overall cap not established
Ablations do not separately identify QA independence, schema, role tools/skills, progressive disclosure or rollback

directly_supported: Preserve artifact state and evidence state together
Permit priorities to shift among growth, repair and preservation
near_match_only: Optimizer-design and constrained PCQM4Mv2 tasks in FrontierSWE
requires_validation: Negative result as progress and appropriate direction termination
Independent scientific validity beyond execution success
Repeated long-horizon scientific progress per full resource cost
Performance stability across externally improved frontier-model versions
scientific_transfer.important_adaptation: Preserve data/conditions/observations/provenance; permit scientific interpretations and earlier verified claims to be revised by new evidence
scientific_transfer.do_not_reduce_to: Experience-to-skills transfer or B/C/G graph study

five_anchor_integration: HoH contributes sustained project loop and artifact/evidence continuity. Prime supplies native substrate under project identity. Root must reconcile Scroll, HarnessDev and RecEvolve from their own full-source reviews.
novelty_limit: Planning-execution-testing, warm-start, evidence feedback, role separation, filesystem context and version history are prior art. Native porting alone is not scholarly novelty; scientific lifecycle adaptation and measured sustained validity across model versions remain candidate contributions only.

claims.claim: Model, base harness, role definitions and runtime policy remain fixed within a run; document, software artifact and evidence evolve.
Same harness-model configuration is invoked separately as planner, developer and tester; runtime constrains authority.
Only developer writes artifact; QA tests a frozen read-only candidate; implementation self-tests do not establish acceptance.
Artifact and evidence are cross-loop channels; prior development document is not the third persistent input channel.
Progressive filesystem disclosure and role tools/skills are described; benchmark setting excludes additional tools, skills and version control.
Public execution QA enters replanning; hidden evaluator outputs remain outside the loop.
GameCraft/Codex pass-controlled comparison favors HoH but token counts are not exactly matched.
Ablations of replanning, evidence feedback and artifact warm-start reduce mean performance in the reported configuration.
One valid run per task-condition, with infrastructure/transport failure replacement and no common generation seed control.
Two FrontierSWE research tasks provide bounded code/experiment optimization evidence, not sustained open-ended scientific discovery evidence.
FPS case analysis cutoff is 70 loops, with human network/API restoration and 65/81 closed issues, 16 unresolved and 17 reopened.
Do not use main-text all-ablations-underperform-on-every-task claim: Lighthouse warm-start ablation 81.50 exceeds full 80.90.
Planner code-read authority differs between main method and appendix prompt.
Do not merge main 12-configuration dominance and 10-loop 11-checkpoint dominance; introductory 22 percent baseline disagrees with detailed 27.33 percent.
No rendered-figure inspection, source-code enforcement audit, local reproduction, full monetary cost, or sustained scientific discovery validation was performed in this review.
Supplied extract does not expose ProgramBench task count/protocol detail or PXI participant count and result table.
